iteration_budget.description: Maximum loop iterations for this goal; null means unlimited. Tokens are not a budget unit.

time_used_ms.description: Accumulated active wall-clock milliseconds through updated_at, including tools. While status is active, add max(0, now - updated_at) for the live duration. Inactive time is excluded; resume preserves this count and replacement resets it.

iterations_used.description: Completed model responses and their tools, including prose, empty responses and the completion summary. Provider retries within one request are not separate iterations.

session.description: Session metadata. goal is null until an explicit /goal or SDK request creates it. Other session fields are not yet constrained here.

agent_name.description: Coding-agent name resolved by the gateway from the session workspace configuration.

session_group_color.description: Closed palette token a session group is painted with. Every channel maps a token to its own theme, so a group keeps its identity across the TUI, the companion app and the web UI. Never a hex string.

input_tokens.description: Token count of the rejected per-question decision sequence, including state and question structure.

max_input_tokens.description: Configured encoder token limit for one decision question.

parent.description: Id of the setting that this row belongs under.

children.description: Settings that belong under this row, in display order. Children can have children.
